bounded_interface_domain: An actual artifact, state, configuration, population, time horizon and receiving decision are identified as specified in the literal common-object field.
The exact native source mechanism contributes the named evidence, constraint, capability or interpretation to that receiving use. Generic possible co-use is insufficient.

Authority, representative evidence, hidden state, shared failure domains, response capability and binding constraints remain separate premises.
Unknown correspondence remains unknown; a low-consequence cheap path and an adequate existing mechanism remain eligible.
source_record.native_common_basis: Use reliability budgets only where the objective, measurement, consequences and authority make the trade-off legitimate.
common_cost_and_alternative: Account for structural work, requalification, telemetry, isolation, rehearsal, backup, coexistence, maintenance and delayed beneficial change; do not count the same shared capacity twice.
Compare existing verified seams, a manual controlled release, targeted checks, simulation, a qualified pilot, roll-forward repair, replacement and deliberate retirement as applicable.
A frozen stage, infrequent release or no change may be adequate; no universal deployment cadence or additional approver follows.
Binding constraints and explicitly nontradeable harms limit the choice set independently of ordinary service-budget economics.
source_record.evidence_ceiling: Root analytical arguments from complete selected native bodies and seven own finite controls. Two bounded practitioner-source accesses corroborate mechanisms, not universal causal effects. No deployed experiment, new property, whole synthesis completion or independent acceptance.

common_subconditions.P1: The precise common object and actual receiving use exist.
common_subconditions.P2: The full source and receiver meanings govern, including cheap paths and rejected universal claims.
common_subconditions.P3: The literal separately reasoned partial consequence follows under its guard.
common_subconditions.P4: The stronger-claim witness, residual premises, alternatives and re-entry remain.

source_record.inference: The specifically identified partial capability, evidence or scope constraint is material to the receiving decision. This does not establish complete recovery, a universal cost curve, a deployment cadence, an authority grant or a new control requirement.
source_record.common_source_dependence: Both new practitioner sources belong to the Google SRE ecosystem; no independent causal replication or duplicate credit. Shared artifacts and controls remain shared.
source_record.reentry: Reopen the affected literal direction if configuration, state, population, timing, coupling, exposure, recovery evidence, source version, receiving use, support horizon or authority changes. A failed guard does not establish a global negative; reverse and transitive claims require separate inquiry.

positive_controls.argument: The user-relevant objective, measured reliability consumption and actual stop authority specify a concrete availability constraint and trade-off for architectural alternatives, rather than a vague demand for maximum reliability.

The actual SLI and budget calculation identify the functional behavior and time/population boundary that reconciliation must bind to the operating state; observed violations can expose a mismatch with approved assumptions.

A defined reliability objective and credible observations supply a specific performance quantity and acceptance context that envelope evidence can address; this is a bounded service facet, not a substitute for qualification.

Credible service-failure observations and an enforceable halt condition can supply limited evidence and a control response for that named pathway, while hazard severity and residual-risk authority remain separate.

Measured consumption and the agreed decision rule provide one concrete condition for proceeding, slowing or pausing the cutover, including a reason to withhold an otherwise technically ready candidate.
The objective and measured loss identify the available time or loss tolerance against which a proposed response can be judged, giving a concrete recovery-performance requirement.
Reliability observations and the agreed change policy reveal whether patching, replacement or support capacity is needed to maintain the specific service commitment over its retained life.
The objective, observed consumption and halt authority supply a concrete feedback variable for selecting or adjusting change controls within that service scope.

Measured outage consumption exposes an operative failure-loss component that can differ at the same phase or remain unchanged across phases, giving a reason to evaluate real consequence rather than assume a universal curve.
